ns2:section.sectionText: TOPIC: Shostakovich String Quartets. Restricted to students in the Music Department NOTE: If you have not been assigned to a string chamber group, register for this section. After getting your assignment and coach, change your registration to that coach's section. Due to the nature of music ensembles, required performances will occur at times other than class times, and additional required rehearsals may be announced.
ns2:section.sectionDeptRestriction: Restricted to students in the Music department.
